## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* Northern-Sòng annotated commentary by **Cóngyì** 從義 (1042–1091) on Zhànrán's *Kē shǐzhōng xīnyào* ([KR6d0215](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0215)). Companion to Cóngyì's other Sòng *shānjiā* productions ([KR6d0063](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0063), [KR6d0139](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0139), [KR6d0140](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0140), [KR6d0169](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0169)).

**Abstract**

The composition is bracketed within Cóngyì's productive period c. 1062–1091.
